fusions.name: Held at Full Draw
fusions.desc: Looses one strike at an enemy up to 8 tiles away. It deals 27 damage, rising to 2 times that at full reach, is always a critical hit, and leaves the target [Poisoned] for 3 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Gall-Tipped Shafts
fusions.desc: Looses a fang-tipped arrow that deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Spitter's Reach
fusions.desc: For 20 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: Straight to the Blood
fusions.desc: Your poison damage cannot be resisted.
